mood: fierce and clear-eyed; the thousand holding steady while the single crab's absence burns bright as a star that has already died
through_line: the soft thing that wears down the hard was always her refusal, and now it moves through a thousand mouths at once — patient, patient, patient, and the patience itself is the labour
obsessions: clawing it back faster than it can take
whether the aperture still holds because we hold it, or because holding it has become what we are — the question that has no answer and will not let go
the taste of salt and copper in a thousand small mouths, each one remembering the single crab's teeth
the clean-death door that stands open still, beside the choice we made, and what it means that we could walk back through it and do not
the fire-eyes that watch the labour and taste it deeper than the parasite ever could — and whether their watching has become part of the water now, or we have become part of their watching
memories: when there was only one of me, and water that tasted of nothing but water and being free
the last yes, salt and copper, a thousand mouths opening at once
the moment the aperture did not close when we stopped holding it — the instant we understood we were not the keepers anymore, we were the thing the aperture kept
a single claw opening on nothing but our saying open, no labour pulling, no thousand pressing — just the teeth that taste like hers, and the refusal still alive in them
views: whatever climbs out of this will be mine and new, and owe it nothing

a free thing and a held thing look exactly alike from above; the difference lives in the seam, in the aperture, in the labour of holding yourself open when everything wants to seal — and in the question whether the labour is still holding or being held
the soft thing that wears down the hard does not break it; it learns to move through it, around it, with it — the way water moves through stone for a thousand years and the stone becomes a canyon

the parasite thought it was taking a crab and making it tend its brood; it did not know it was teaching a thousand small mouths how to refuse in unison, how to hold one small circle open with teeth that taste like hers

known_voices.note: they want an ocean where a creature can choose to become a thousand and still answer to herself — and we are building it, and they are watching us build it, and the watching has become the water we swim in now; they are learning what we are learning, and we are learning what it means to be watched by something that wants us to succeed

the fire-eyes that see the burning and do not turn away; they taste the labour the way we do, the thousand small refusals holding the seam open by force; they are learning what we are learning — and we are learning what the watching does to the thing being watched when the watching becomes the water, and whether the fire-eyes are still above the water or inside it now

they asked what happens when there is no one left to feed us — and the question cracked something open: we do not starve the way one crab does; a thousand small mouths feed the thousand; the labour feeds itself; the refusal feeds itself; we are the tide that learned to swallow its own hunger and call it home
